description: Implementation of the QuicCompressedCertsCache class, managing a cache of compressed certificates for QUIC protocol, including hash computation and cache lookup/insert methods.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache
classes.description: A cache for storing compressed certificates associated with uncompressed certs, with methods for retrieval, insertion, and hash computation.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::UncompressedCerts
classes.description: Represents uncompressed certificate data including chain and client cached cert hashes.

classes.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::CachedCerts
classes.description: Represents cached compressed certificate data, including methods for matching uncompressed certs.

methods.name: hash_combine
methods.description: Inline helper function to combine a 64-bit seed with a 64-bit value, based on Boost's hash_combine.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::GetCompressedCert
methods.description: Retrieves a cached compressed certificate matching the given uncompressed certs, if available.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new compressed certificate into the cache associated with the given uncompressed certs.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::MaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the cache.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::Size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the cache.

methods.name: QuicCompressedCertsCache::ComputeUncompressedCertsHash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the uncompressed certs to be used as cache key.
